description: CobbleDollars Villagers Overhaul [RCA] is a standalone NeoForge mod that replaces the vanilla villager trade GUI with a CobbleDollars-style shop, adds buy/sell tabs and balance display, and allows villagers to take CobbleDollars instead of emeralds (with Cobblemon + CobbleDollars installed).

releases.notes:
## CobbleDollars Villagers Overhaul 0.5.0

**Minecraft 1.21.1 · Fabric & NeoForge · Cobblemon 1.8.0+ · CobbleDollars Beta-5.1 / Beta-6.1**

### What's new
- **Every villager can have its own shop.** Assign a villager and it gets its own items, prices and sell list. Editing one villager never changes another one or the default shop.
- **Name your shops.** Give a villager's shop a name like "Shop Guga". The shopkeeper keeps their own name.
- **Optional Sell and Trades tabs.** Off by default for custom villagers, and you can switch each on per villager.
- **Custom trades.** Set up trades where the player gives one or two items, and optionally pays CobbleDollars, for an item. Villagers' normal and datapack trades still show first.
- **Scrolling category tabs** when a shop has more than 5 categories, and empty categories now get a tab too.
- **Easier config.** The menu is grouped into Shop, Prices, Look and General. The editors are easier to read and have back buttons. The shared shop is now called **Default shop**, the template new villager shops start from.

### Fixed
- **Radical Cobblemon Trainers (RCT 0.19):** trading with a trainer association now changes your series again, on both Fabric and NeoForge. If you're stuck on freeroam with no previous series, all series are listed so you can pick one.
- The Edit button inside a villager's shop opened the shared default shop instead of that villager's own shop.
- Blurry titles and names on the editor screens.

Villagers assigned before this update keep using the default shop until you edit them.
